propositions: The completion child-closure gate performs a full-store scan per child when closing a container, scaling O(5N) with child count due to current fingerprint computation plus legacy-generation retries and stale-material explanation

The cost arises from looping per-child compute_validity calls in completion_child_gate.py that each recompute current_material_fingerprint via reduce_all_tickets, with up to 5 full scans per child (1 current + 3 legacy + 1 explanation)

Wrapping the per-child validity loop in a material_child_index snapshot (matching the remedy in sibling bug 3d57) reduces full-store scan count to constant-in-child-count by memoizing live_material_children across all children
Child gate verdicts remain correct after the fix: a child attesting its true fingerprint stays certified, stale children land uncertified, and unclosed children still block container close
